diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says VM, datasheet reading says AIN1
diffs.evidence: Adafruit's Eagle board file for #3297: 8-pin header JP5 (package 1X08_ROUND_70 at y=11.43, rot R270) pad 1 is on signal 'VMOTOR' (<contactref element="JP5" pad="1"/>); pad 1 sits at y=20.32 mm next to silkscreen text 'VM' (y=22.606). Silkscreen order from pad 1 to pad 8: VM GND FLT BIN1 BIN2 SLP AIN2 AIN1. The second reading lists the same eight pins in exact reverse order, i.e. it counted from the AIN1 end; pad 1 is the VM end. The pin's identity and function are the same, only the numbering differs. The TI datasheet only covers the chip package, not this header.
